data.name: Stick Happens
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to STICK HAPPENS™: A Wobbly, Whimsical Co-op Adventure!

Grab your friends, pick your favorite ridiculous hat, and get ready for a floppy, physics-filled vacation! In STICK HAPPENS, you and your crew are stranded on a chain of vibrant, sun-drenched islands. The only problem? A bunch of quirky, mischievous monsters are trying to ruin your tropical getaway.

It’s up to your squishy team to stick together, explore stunning landscapes, and whack away the chaos before it overwhelms you!

Key Features:

  • Frantic Co-op: Run, jump, and stumble through combat. Coordination is key as you swing, throw, and flail your way through waves of goofy enemies. Just try not to whack your friends in the process!

  • Whimsical & Wacky Monsters: Forget terrifying beasts—you'll be facing off against delightfully silly creatures! From grumpy mushrooms hiding in the grass to bouncy, over-enthusiastic sea critters, every encounter is more funny than frightening.

  • Explore Vibrant Islands: Traverse a variety of colorful environments. Battle across golden wheat fields, wander through magical forests with bright blue trees and red grass, or sail to the next island on your trusty little boat.

  • Customize your wobbly hero: Whether you want to conquer the islands as a pirate, a royal king, a jester, or even wearing a giant duck on your head, you can fight off monsters in peak style.

  • Online Multiplayer Mayhem: Gather your crew online for some hilarious teamwork. STICK HAPPENS is the perfect game for groups who love laughing at their own clumsy mistakes while trying to save the day together.

Will you work together to conquer the islands, or will you just flop around and let chaos take over? Remember: when you're having this much fun, Stick Happens!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD Phenom II X4 965
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000) lub NVIDIA GeForce GTS 450
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
